requirements.acceptance_criterion: Human-error analysis with countermeasures.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Person detection triggers protective reaction in time
requirements.statement: The protective function detects persons in the defined zone and initiates slow-down/stop early enough that moving parts cannot start up while persons are within reach and cannot be reached while moving.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Detection zone, response time and stopping performance verified against the separation distance.
requirements.assessor_guidance: Check zone geometry, response time chain (camera→inference→logic→drive) and separation distance calculation.
requirements.expected_evidence: V&V / test report; Safety requirements specification
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Protective device not easily defeated; adjustment intentional
requirements.statement: The protective device is not easy to by-pass or render non-operational, and can be adjusted only by intentional action.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Defeat analysis; adjustment protected (tools/credentials).
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Automatic start/restart only when safe
requirements.statement: In automatic mode, starting, restarting after a stop or changing operating conditions without intervention is possible only where no hazardous situation results.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Restart conditions specified and verified (e.g. zone clear confirmed).
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Interruption to a safe state at any time
requirements.statement: Operation can be interrupted at any time via a stop control or similar procedure that brings the system to a safe state; emergency stop is available in all operating modes.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Stop and emergency-stop functions verified in all modes incl. AI fault states.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Mode selection overrides; non-AI mode
requirements.statement: The selected control/operating mode overrides other modes (except emergency stop); where provided, a mode without the AI function allows operation without relying on it.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Mode concept documented and verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Autonomous mobile machinery: safety functions performed autonomously
requirements.statement: For autonomous mobile machinery, the control system performs the safety functions by itself, also when actions are ordered via a remote supervisory function.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Safety functions independent of supervisor link verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Human–machine coexistence and interaction
requirements.statement: Prevention of contact risks and of psychological stress is adapted to human–machine coexistence in a shared space and to human–machine interaction.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Coexistence/interaction scenarios analysed with measures.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: AI integrity target determined
requirements.statement: From the hazard and risk analysis, the risk-reduction target of the safety function using AI is determined (e.g. as SIL or PL) and translated, as defined by the applied AI standard, into the required systematic capability of the AI part, the target failure measure or risk-reduction factor, and the hardware/software platform requirements.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Risk-reduction target and required systematic capability documented and consistent with the applied standard and the project tags INT.PL/INT.SIL/INT.AISC.
requirements.expected_evidence: Risk assessment / HARA; Safety requirements specification
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Stand-alone requirement, selected through its source (D0026).

requirements.title: AI-specific HW/SW and interface requirements specified and implemented
requirements.statement: Requirements for the hardware and software specific to the AI and for their interfaces to non-AI components are specified, documented and implemented accordingly.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Requirements traceable to the safety requirements and to design/verification evidence.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Stand-alone requirement, selected through its source (D0026).

requirements.title: Effective human oversight by design
requirements.statement: The system is designed with appropriate human–machine interface tools so that natural persons can effectively oversee it while in use.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Oversight concept with roles, HMI elements and their purpose.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Oversight measures commensurate with risk and autonomy
requirements.statement: Oversight measures are commensurate with the risks, level of autonomy and context of use.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Built-in oversight measures
requirements.statement: Oversight measures built into the system by the provider are identified and implemented where technically feasible.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Measures listed and verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Deployer oversight measures
requirements.statement: Oversight measures to be implemented by the deployer are identified and communicated.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Measures stated in IFU.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Monitoring and anomaly detection by overseers
requirements.statement: Overseers can understand the capacities and limitations, monitor operation and detect anomalies, dysfunctions and unexpected performance; indicators needed for safe operation are readable from the control position.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Status/diagnostic indications defined incl. AI-specific states (degraded, out-of-ODD).
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Automation bias addressed
requirements.statement: Overseers are enabled to remain aware of the tendency to over-rely on the AI output (automation bias).
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Measures against over-reliance (training, HMI cues, procedures) documented.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Interpretable outputs and information
requirements.statement: Operation is sufficiently transparent for deployers to interpret outputs; information needed for control is unambiguous, easily understood and not overloading.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: HMI/information design reviewed with users or against criteria.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Override and non-use possible
requirements.statement: Overseers can decide not to use the AI function or to disregard, override or reverse its output without creating a hazard.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Override/bypass path specified and safe.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: HMI adapted to operators
requirements.statement: The human–machine interface is adapted to the foreseeable characteristics of the operators.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Operator profile and HMI design rationale.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Self-evolving machinery communicates with people
requirements.statement: Machinery with self-evolving behaviour responds to people adequately and communicates its planned actions comprehensibly.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Communication concept verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Supervisory function (autonomous mobile machinery)
requirements.statement: The supervisory function meets the requirements for permitted actions, information, alerts and interlocking.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Permitted supervisor actions
requirements.statement: The supervisory function only allows remote stop/start or moving to a safe position and state, and only when the supervisor can see the working area and protective devices are operational.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Verified by design review and test.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Complete supervisor information
requirements.statement: The supervisor receives a complete and accurate view of operation, movement and safe positioning.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Verified by design review and test.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Alerts to supervisor
requirements.statement: The supervisor is alerted to unforeseen or dangerous situations requiring intervention.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Verified by design review and test.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: No operation without supervision
requirements.statement: The machinery cannot operate if the supervisory function is not active.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Verified by design review and test.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Operator intervention limited and safe
requirements.statement: The need for operator intervention is limited; where unavoidable, intervention is easy and safe.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Intervention cases listed with safe procedures.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Oversight without sustained vigilance
requirements.statement: Oversight does not rely on monitoring that requires lengthy concentration; it is supported by alerts.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Alert-driven oversight concept.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: AI output used for operator safety decisions
requirements.statement: Where AI output is presented to an operator for a safety decision, its uncertainty, the presentation, hazard severity and required reaction time are considered, including wrong or too-slow reactions in the hazard and risk analysis.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: HARA and HMI design cover these aspects.
requirements.assessor_guidance: N/A – feature absent when the AI output acts directly on the safety function without operator decision.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Stand-alone requirement, selected through its source (D0026).

requirements.title: Level of automation and supervision analysed
requirements.statement: The level of automation of the AI system and the resulting control and intervention options of humans are determined; supervision of automated decisions (technical supervisor or human) is decided, and the risk-reducing effect and new risks of human supervision are analysed.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Automation level stated (no automation … autonomy); supervision concept with allocation of decisions; analysis of human-in-the-loop effectiveness and induced risks.
requirements.assessor_guidance: A protective device that stops the machine without operator involvement is typically "full automation" of the safety decision; operator override must not defeat the safety function.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Derived requirement (rule A8), stand-alone (D0026).

requirements.title: Automatic event logging over lifetime
requirements.statement: The system technically allows automatic recording of events (logs) over its lifetime.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Logging specification and implementation verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Logs identify risk situations and modifications
requirements.statement: Logged events enable identification of situations that may present a risk and of substantial modifications.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Event list mapped to risk situations/modification events.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Logs support PMM and deployer monitoring
requirements.statement: Logged events facilitate post-market monitoring and monitoring of operation by the deployer.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Log content usable for PMM indicators and deployer monitoring.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Tracing log of interventions and safety-software versions (5 years)
requirements.statement: A tracing log of data on interventions and of safety-software versions uploaded after placing on the market is enabled for five years after upload, for authority requests.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Log mechanism and retention verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Safety decision data recorded (1 year)
requirements.statement: For self-evolving systems, data on the safety-related decision-making process are recorded and retained for one year, for authority requests.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Recording and retention verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Provider keeps logs (≥ 6 months)
requirements.statement: Logs under the provider's control are kept for a period appropriate to the intended purpose, at least six months.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Retention rule and storage verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Evidence of interventions collected
requirements.statement: Evidence of legitimate or illegitimate interventions in compliance-critical hardware/software, software modifications and configuration changes is collected.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Audit trail of interventions and changes.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Diagnostic and log access
requirements.statement: A connection for diagnostic fault-finding equipment is provided where needed, and deployers can collect, store and interpret logs.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Diagnostic interface/log export described.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Inputs recorded for reproduction of safety decisions
requirements.statement: Input data are recorded to the extent needed to reproduce safety-relevant decisions for post-incident analysis, in compliance with data-protection requirements.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Recording and replay specification (trigger, buffer, retention); replay demonstrated; data-protection assessment.
requirements.assessor_guidance: Example: event-triggered ring buffer of input frames around each stop.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Derived requirement (rule A8), stand-alone (D0026).

requirements.title: Connected devices do not create hazards
requirements.statement: Connection of other devices, directly or remotely, does not lead to a hazardous situation.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Interface threat/hazard analysis.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Hardware access paths protected
requirements.statement: Hardware components transmitting signals/data relevant for access to compliance-critical software are protected against accidental or intentional corruption.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Protection measures verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Critical software and data identified and protected
requirements.statement: Software and data critical for compliance (incl. trained models, parameters and safety-relevant data sets) are identified and protected against accidental or intentional corruption.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Inventory of critical items with integrity protection.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Installed safety software identifiable
requirements.statement: The product identifies the software needed for safe operation and provides that information at all times in an easily accessible form.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Version display/query verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Resilience against unauthorised third parties
requirements.statement: The system resists attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter its use, outputs or performance by exploiting vulnerabilities; solutions are appropriate to the risks.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Threat analysis and security tests.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: AI-specific attacks addressed
requirements.statement: Measures prevent, detect, respond to and control AI-specific attacks: data poisoning, model poisoning, adversarial examples/evasion, confidentiality attacks and model flaws.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Attack catalogue with measures and test evidence.
requirements.assessor_guidance: Person detection: adversarial patches/clothing, camera blinding, spoofing; training-data provenance.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Controls protected; remote control unambiguous
requirements.statement: Unauthorised use of controls is prevented; remote controls affect only the intended machinery and functions and respond only to intended control units.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Access control and pairing verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Safety-function limits; hazardous modifications prevented
requirements.statement: Limits of the safety functions are established in the risk assessment; modifications of settings or rules by the machinery or by operators (incl. during learning) that could lead to hazardous situations are prevented.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Parameter/rule protection and limit enforcement verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Pre-determined changes defined
requirements.statement: Changes to the system and its performance pre-determined at the initial conformity assessment are described with the solutions ensuring continuous compliance.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Change envelope documented or "none" stated.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Self-evolving: actions within task and movement space
requirements.statement: Self-evolving behaviour does not cause actions beyond the defined task and movement space.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Envelope enforcement independent of learning verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Self-evolving: correction always possible
requirements.statement: It is possible at all times to correct the machinery to maintain its inherent safety.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Correction/rollback mechanism verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Continual learning: feedback loops mitigated
requirements.statement: For systems that continue to learn, biased outputs influencing future inputs (feedback loops) are eliminated or mitigated.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Feedback-loop analysis and measures.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Changes notified to the notified body
requirements.statement: Where a notified body is involved, the manufacturer informs it of all modifications to the approved type or technical documentation (module B) or intended changes to the approved quality system (module H) that may affect conformity or certificate validity, monitors the state of the art, and requests review of the EU type-examination certificate on modification, on state-of-the-art change and before expiry (renewal application 12 to 6 months before expiry; simplified review where nothing changed).
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Change procedure contains the notified-body notification step; records of notifications and certificate reviews.
requirements.assessor_guidance: AI examples of modifications to the approved type: retraining or new model weights, changed training data, changed decision thresholds or operating domain. Agree change-impact criteria with the notified body; link to pre-determined changes (CR.CHG.002).
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Modification impact analysis and re-verification
requirements.statement: For modifications, including changed or replaced training data, the affected life-cycle phases are revisited, an impact analysis is made for each affected AI component, continued suitability is checked and relevant tests and analyses are repeated.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Impact analysis and re-verification records per change.
requirements.assessor_guidance: Link to notified-body notification (CR.CHG.007) where a certificate exists.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Stand-alone requirement, selected through its source (D0026).

requirements.title: IFU form and language
requirements.statement: Instructions for use are provided in an appropriate (incl. digital) format, are concise, complete, correct, clear and comprehensible, and in a language easily understood by users; wording fits non-professional users where applicable; they clearly identify the product model to which they correspond.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: intended use, misuse and risk circumstances
requirements.statement: The IFU describe the intended purpose/use, ways the product must not be used, reasonably foreseeable misuse and circumstances that may lead to risks.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.

requirements.title: IFU: provider identity

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: characteristics, capabilities and limitations

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: declared accuracy, robustness, cybersecurity
requirements.statement: The IFU declare the tested and validated levels of accuracy (with metrics), robustness and cybersecurity, and circumstances affecting them.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: explanation capabilities

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: performance for persons/groups
requirements.statement: Where appropriate, the IFU state performance for specific persons or groups (e.g. body size, posture, clothing, PPE).
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: input data specification
requirements.statement: Where appropriate, the IFU specify input data and relevant information on training, validation and testing data.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: interpreting output
requirements.statement: Where applicable, the IFU enable deployers to interpret the output and use it appropriately.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: pre-determined changes
requirements.statement: The IFU describe pre-determined changes to the system and its performance.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: oversight measures and training
requirements.statement: The IFU describe the human-oversight measures, technical aids for interpreting outputs, and instructions for putting into service and training of operators.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: resources, lifetime, maintenance, updates
requirements.statement: The IFU state computational and hardware resources, expected lifetime, maintenance and care measures incl. software updates, and safety-relevant spare-part specifications.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: log mechanisms
requirements.statement: Where relevant, the IFU describe the mechanisms for deployers to collect, store and interpret logs.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: residual risks and protective measures
requirements.statement: Warnings and information on residual risks and on protective measures to be taken by the user, incl. PPE and training needs, are provided.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Sales literature consistent
requirements.statement: Sales literature does not contradict the IFU on health and safety aspects, incl. AI performance claims.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: IFU: autonomous mobile machinery areas
requirements.statement: The IFU of autonomous mobile machinery specify the intended travel and working areas and danger zones.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Content present, correct and consistent with the technical documentation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Warning devices for faults
requirements.statement: Where a fault in unsupervised operation may endanger persons, an acoustic or light warning is given; warning devices are unambiguous, easily perceived and checkable.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Warning concept verified.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Product identification marking
requirements.statement: The product bears at least the model, series or type designation, the year of construction and any batch or serial number or other identifying element, or, where size or nature do not allow, this information is on the packaging or in an accompanying document.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Marking present and matches the DoC and technical documentation.

requirements.title: Manufacturer contact details on the product

requirements.title: Digital instructions for use
requirements.statement: Where the instructions for use are digital: how to access them is marked on the product (or packaging/accompanying document); they can be printed, downloaded and saved (also when embedded in software); they are online for the expected lifetime and at least 10 years; a paper copy is provided free of charge within one month on request at purchase.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: All conditions met for the digital format used.

requirements.title: Paper safety information for non-professional users

requirements.title: Transparency and explainability evaluated per recipient

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Evaluation report per recipient covering the four questions; documentation set (model description, data set description, known limitations); trade-off rationale.
requirements.assessor_guidance: Output transparency for diagnostics: confidence, bounding box, zone assignment.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Derived requirement (rule A8), stand-alone (D0026).

requirements.title: Reward hacking analysed and prevented
requirements.statement: Where the AI learns from a reward or objective function, ways of gaming the reward against safety constraints are analysed and countered (e.g. independent verification of reward claims, decoupled reward based on the true safety outcome).
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Reward-hacking scenarios listed with prevention measures and verification.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Derived requirement (rule A8), stand-alone (D0026).

requirements.title: Safe exploration ensured
requirements.statement: Where the AI explores or manipulates its environment during data collection, training or operation, a priori safety requirements are enforced during exploration and exploration is disconnected from the hazardous process.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Exploration boundaries and safety constraints specified; independent safety monitor during adaptation; offline or simulated exploration where possible.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Derived requirement (rule A8), stand-alone (D0026).

requirements.title: Robust learning techniques applied
requirements.statement: Robust-learning techniques appropriate to the expected disturbances and to the requirement level are applied and their effect evaluated: model-size comparison, regularisation or dropout, randomised training, fault-aware training, adversarially robust training or certified bounds, randomised smoothing, augmentation for out-of-distribution robustness; numerical or formal stability analysis at high levels.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Selected techniques with rationale per disturbance; robustness evaluation results (e.g. perturbation sensitivity, safe radius) before and after; techniques consistent with the requirement level.
requirements.assessor_guidance: Requirement level (Annex C.5) — low: regularisation, cross-validation, randomised training, model-size exploration; middle: + adversarial training, smoothing, adversarial example tests; high: + maximum safe radius, formally checked robust training.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Derived requirement (rule A8), stand-alone (D0026).

requirements.title: Explanations validated and used as supporting evidence only
requirements.statement: Where explainability techniques (e.g. saliency or attention maps) support verification or audit, their suitability for the model and output type and their validity are checked, the explanations are checked for consistency with the safety requirements, and they are not used as the sole justification of safe behaviour.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: XAI method specification with suitability rationale; validity checks (e.g. model-parameter randomisation test); analysis of failure cases and sampled correct outputs per stratum incl. spurious correlations found; findings traced to HARA, fault model or data actions.
requirements.assessor_guidance: For detectors, black-box saliency (e.g. D-RISE) or detector-adapted Grad-CAM; raw transformer attention is not evidence. Typical findings: reliance on floor markings, high-visibility clothing or site-specific background.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: Derived requirement (rule A8), stand-alone (D0026).

requirements.acceptance_criterion: Classification statement with justification, consistent with the scoping tag AI.cat.
requirements.assessor_guidance: Examples: Annex I Part A items 5/6 (self-evolving ML safety components or machinery with embedded such systems); Part B item 15 (protective devices detecting persons) and item 17 (logic units for safety functions). A camera-based person detector with a frozen model typically falls under Part B item 15. The classification must be consistent with the project tags AI.cat, prod.type and conf.module.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Permitted conformity assessment procedure applied
requirements.statement: One of the conformity assessment procedures permitted for the classification has been applied (Art 25(2)-(4)).
requirements.author: Catalogue author
requirements.notes: OR: the route set in tag conf.module is applicable; the others are N/A by rule. If conf.module is not set, all routes stay applicable with "assessor to confirm".

requirements.title: Module A (internal production control) applied
requirements.statement: Internal production control (Annex VI) is applied: technical documentation, manufacturing control, CE marking and EU declaration of conformity under the manufacturer's sole responsibility. For Annex I Part B products, only where the product is designed and constructed in accordance with harmonised standards or common specifications specific to its category that cover all relevant essential health and safety requirements.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Module A is permitted only for products not listed in Annex I, or for Annex I Part B products where the list of applied category-specific harmonised standards / common specifications shows full coverage of every applicable EHSR; otherwise this route fails (never permitted for Annex I Part A). Module A records complete.
requirements.assessor_guidance: For AI-based person detection, check whether any cited harmonised standard covers the AI-specific EHSRs (e.g. 1.1.9, 1.2.1); a standard written for conventional sensing (e.g. the IEC 61496 series) does not cover machine-learning behaviour. Check citation status in the OJ at the assessment date.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Module B + C (EU type-examination + conformity to type) applied
requirements.statement: A valid EU type-examination certificate (Annex VII) covering the product type and version placed on the market has been obtained from a notified body after an application with the required content, and conformity to type based on internal production control (Annex VIII) is ensured and declared.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Product is listed in Annex I (Part A or B). Certificate valid (≤ 5 years, not withdrawn), names the product type and the applied standards/specifications; product version on the market matches the certified type.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Module H (full quality assurance) applied
requirements.statement: An approved quality system for design, manufacture, final inspection and testing (Annex IX) is operated, maintained adequate and effective, and subject to notified-body surveillance with access to sites and records.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Product is listed in Annex I (Part A or B). Notified-body approval decision valid; latest surveillance audit report without open major findings.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Module G (unit verification) applied

requirements.acceptance_criterion: DoC contains all applicable Annex V Part A particulars; references (product identification, standards with dates, notified body and certificate) match the technical documentation and certificates; signed and dated.

requirements.title: EU declaration of conformity provided with the product
requirements.statement: The product is accompanied by the EU declaration of conformity, or the instructions for use state the internet address or machine-readable code where it can be accessed; a digital declaration remains accessible online for the expected lifetime and for at least 10 years after placing on the market.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: DoC or access path supplied; online availability ensured for the required period.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Reporting deadlines
requirements.statement: Reports are made immediately after a causal link (or its reasonable likelihood) is established, at the latest 15 days after awareness; 2 days for widespread infringements or critical-infrastructure incidents; 10 days in case of death; an initial incomplete report may precede the complete one.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Procedure defines the deadlines and escalation.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Incident investigation and cooperation
requirements.statement: Serious incidents are investigated without delay incl. risk assessment and corrective action, in cooperation with authorities and without altering the system before informing them.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Investigation procedure and records.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Corrective action, withdrawal or recall
requirements.statement: When the manufacturer considers or has reason to believe that a product placed on the market is non-conforming, it immediately takes corrective action, withdraws or recalls it, and where the product presents a risk immediately informs the competent national authorities with details of the non-conformity and corrective actions.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Procedure with triggers, decision criteria and authority notification; records of cases.
requirements.author: Catalogue author

requirements.title: Information and cooperation on authority request
requirements.statement: Upon reasoned request of a competent national authority, all information and documentation needed to demonstrate conformity (incl. a copy of the EU declaration of conformity) is provided in paper or digital form in an easily understood language, and the manufacturer cooperates on actions to eliminate risks.
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Procedure defines responsibilities and response times.
requirements.author: Catalogue author
